The '''Extravehicular Activity (EVA) Pod''' was a suit of powered [[Armor/Legends|armor]] designed to let the wearer make repairs to [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in a [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]]. It had a low-level [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Droid brain/Legends|brain]] that assisted an inexperienced wearer in its operation. It handled the complicated tasks like maneuvering and monitoring [[Life support/Legends|life support]] so the wearer could concentrate on their task at hand.

It had a fully-sealed life support system with a duration of two hours. It also had an external bay for storage and a full set of engineering tools built into the motorized arms.
